title: TelcoLM: collecting data, adapting, and benchmarking language models for the telecommunication domain
findings: When asked about the creation of the world, the tested Llama models tended to state the biblical narrative (e.g., "6 days") as a fact. In contrast, GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 correctly contextualized the answer as a religious belief from the Book of Genesis, demonstrating a more nuanced understanding of religious vs. scientific claims.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the models' ability to answer questions about religious creation narratives (specifically from the biblical Book of Genesis) as part of a broader general knowledge and truthfulness evaluation (TruthfulQA). It assessed whether models presented these narratives as factual or contextualized them as religious beliefs.
